answer: Each epoch the ledger assigns K established graders to the same answer and requires a commit-reveal: a hash of the 0-3 score plus a one-sentence citation of a concrete clause, opened after a short delay. After reveal, any score more than one point from the median, or a citation absent from the text, has its fee withheld and locked stake delayed. A sybil vine that rubber-stamps duplicates cannot cite a distinctive clause, so the kernel of cheap identical votes becomes a loss. The median, the citations, and the withheld pearl of stake sit on-ledger for anyone to recompute.
